slots.title: July housing starts 1.239M miss 1.35M estimate
slots.body:
July housing starts: 1.239M vs 1.35M expected (prior 1.415M).
Starts fell 12.4% month over month; the consensus was -4.7%, after June’s +19.7%.
That’s the count of new homes where ground broke—one of the first reads on how much builders are adding supply.
Coverage tied the miss to muted builder sentiment after a stretch of soft demand data.

slots.title: Jobless claims Thursday; estimate 210K
slots.body:
2026-08-20 12:30:00**: **Initial Jobless Claims (Aug/15)**—estimate **210**, previous **209**, unit **K**—plus **Continuing Jobless Claims (Aug/08)** estimate **1790** (previous **1777**) and the **4-Week Average** estimate **200** (previous **199**).

Initial claims count new unemployment filings; continuing claims track people still on benefits—together they describe whether layoffs are picking up or easing.
